name: Key Coffee Inc.
summary: Key Coffee Inc. engages in the coffee business in Japan and internationally. The company produces and markets coffee, food ingredients and tea products for commercial, household; and food and beverage services at directly managed stores include providing customers with drinks, food, sweets, etc. It also operates a plantation business. In addition, the company offers home-brewed and professional-use products. It serves consumers, restaurants, food wholesalers, beverage manufacturers. The company was formerly known as Kimura Shotten and changed its name to Key Coffee Inc. Key Coffee Inc. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
